{{Top|leg}}
A '''muzzle flash suppressor''' was a [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] weapon attachment. It helped to conceal the muzzle flash of the weapon when it was fired, allowing it to be used more effectively by [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]].<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|Tasariq: The Crystal Planet}}</ref>
